candidate.answerReason: Removing the 20-yuan base fee leaves 30 yuan of call charges. Dividing by 0.1 yuan per minute gives 300 minutes.

methods.label: Solve the bill equation
methods.explanation: The bill is $y=20+0.1x$. Setting $y=50$ gives $0.1x=30$, so $x=300$.
methods.levelReason: Uses a Grade 8 linear model and reverse function evaluation, with Grade 7 equation solving and elementary decimal division.
